key_findings: LIF suppresses IL-1β-induced NLRP3 activation and pyroptosis in nucleus pulposus cells by downregulating ICAM1 via NF-κB and JAK2/STAT3 inhibition.
LIF overexpression or ICAM1 knockdown ameliorated needle puncture-induced disc degeneration in rats.
